title: High Contrast Scroll Bars
description: Enhances the UI contrast of Minecraft scroll bars
body:
Welcome `user`!  

I assume you have been using the `High Contrast` Minecraft resource pack lately?  
But turns out your whole life is a lie.. Everything in it is high contrast, EXCEPT FOR THE SCROLL BARS!?!?!??!?!?  
LIKE WHAT??  

But wait!! Don't have a heart attack yet!  
This resoure pack includes the scroll bars in the high contrast fun!  
Thats why your here, right? Right?? RIGHT????  

`now stop waisting your time looking at the description and go fix ur scroll bars.. PLEASE!!`
